characteristics: 16-tube 220mm unguided rocket launcher, longer range than BM-21 Grad
Strength: Longer reach than Grad while retaining the simplicity/cost advantage of unguided rockets
Limitation: Still unguided, so accuracy is far below Ukraine's guided MLRS types at comparable range
Estimated quantity available: Fleet size not fully disclosed
employment_notes: Fills the mid-range gap between the short-range Grad and Russia's very long-range Smerch/Tornado systems
contrast_vs_traditional: Uragan fires unguided rockets in a saturating barrage — pure mass-artillery-era doctrine, largely unchanged from its original design intent. It's a useful reminder that not every system on this battlefield has modernized at the same pace: cheap volume fire against an area target still has a role even as the doctrine.md throughline elsewhere is precision, ISR-cued, minutes-scale strikes.
